events.title: Karen Joy Fowler with Yangsze Cho
events.address: 1010 El Camino Real, Menlo Park, CA, 94025, United States
events.description: New York Times bestselling author and Man Booker Prize finalist Karen Joy Fowler returns with Otter Music, a luminous, emotionally resonant story of a marine researcher grappling with whether ecosystems—and people—can truly be saved, set along the shimmering Santa Cruz coast.
events.blurb: Hear Karen Joy Fowler discuss Otter Music, her story of a marine researcher on the Santa Cruz coast, in conversation with Yangsze Cho.

events.title: Illumination: A Celebration of Youth Creativity
events.description: Bay Area Creative presents Illumination: A Celebration of Youth Creativity, a free evening showcasing the visual art, dance, and poetry of students from San José's Franklin-McKinley School District. The event features live student performances and a Best of Show art competition with prizes for the top three artists.
events.blurb: See visual art, dance, and poetry from students in San José's Franklin-McKinley School District at this free evening showcase.
